description: What the sample package tests assert (src/server/packages/sample-data.test.ts): asset counts by type, check results, the v1 to v2 comparison and the Agent Space export. The memory bodies are the contract with the journals.
memoryBodies: checkout-api takes the cart, holds seats through seat-map-service and charges the card through payments-gateway. Logs: /anyco/prod/checkout-api. Owner: team-checkout.

checkout-api takes the cart, holds seats through seat-map-service and charges the card through payments-gateway. Logs: /anyco/prod/checkout-api. Owner: team-checkout.

A 5xx from payments-gateway shows up here as HTTP 502 with error code PGW_UPSTREAM.
seat-map-service serves the venue seat map and seat holds. Holds live in the seat-hold-cache Redis cluster (cluster mode, 3 shards) with a 10-minute TTL. Owner: team-venue.

seat-map-service serves the venue seat map and seat holds. Holds live in the seat-hold-cache Redis cluster (cluster mode, 3 shards) with a 10-minute TTL. Owner: team-venue.

A hold that disappears before its TTL points at evictions. Check the evicted_keys and used_memory metrics before you rule the cache out.
payments-gateway routes card payments to the ExamplePay acquirer. A charge fails when ExamplePay takes longer than 3 seconds. Owner: team-payments.

ExamplePay posts its incidents on its status page. Check that page and the gateway's own TLS and auth errors before you blame a checkout-api deploy.
fulfillment-worker consumes the order-events topic (12 partitions), issues tickets and asks notification-service to send the confirmation email. Owner: team-fulfillment.

fulfillment-worker consumes the order-events topic (12 partitions), issues tickets and asks notification-service to send the confirmation email. Owner: team-fulfillment.

Consumer lag on one partition while the others are at zero means a stuck message, not load.
Seat holds that vanish early usually come from a client bug in the seat map page.
Seat holds that vanish early come from cache evictions more often than from client bugs. Compare evicted_keys and used_memory with the number of active holds.
A price that differs between the event page and checkout is CDN caching. Purge the CDN path.
A price that differs between the event page and checkout can be CDN caching or a pricing flag served to part of the traffic. Check flag changes in the window before you purge anything.
Ratio alarms at night can fire on a handful of requests. Count the requests behind the ratio before you call it an outage.
